description: This file defines a concurrency-safe singleton class 'TranscriptsStore' for storing and managing transcript entries in a log file, with methods for appending new entries and retrieving the latest entries. It also extends the String class with a method to append its content to a file at a specified URL.

classes.name: TranscriptsStore
classes.description: A singleton actor class responsible for managing a transcript log stored in a file, with methods for appending text and retrieving recent entries.

methods.name: init()
methods.description: Initializes the TranscriptsStore by setting up the directory, loading existing entries from the log file, or creating the file if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: append(text: String)
methods.description: Appends a new text entry to the in-memory entries list, maintaining a limit, and writes the updated log to disk.

methods.name: latest() -> [String]
methods.description: Returns the most recent entries stored in the log.
